# GSAP

GSAP 3.13.0 from npm (`gsap@3.13.0`, `dist/`), used by `docs-theme/landing.js` for the landing
page motion: `gsap.min.js` and `ScrollTrigger.min.js`.

GSAP is not MIT. It is free to use under its Standard "no charge" license,
https://gsap.com/standard-license, and each file keeps its license header. The files are kept
here, not loaded from a CDN, so the site loads nothing from a third party for motion.

To update, replace the three files with the same names from a newer `gsap` package.
